name: Supreme x Nike Air Humara 17 'Black'
story_html: Supreme revived the Air Humara trail runner from Nike’s outdoor archive with this October 2017 release. One of four colorways from the collaborative release, this pair differs from its two-tone counterparts with a monochromatic finish. Basic black covers the lightweight mesh upper and synthetic leather overlays, coated in a reflective finish on the toe and heel. An embossed Supreme logo appears on the lateral-side toe wrap, while embossed ‘World’ and ‘Famous’ inscriptions are stamped on the heel tabs of the left and right shoes.
